standing_authority.granted_by_user_statement: 所有真人审核都不需要；整个产品过程中不存在人工；model 与 harness 必须完成生成、审查、批准、删除和合并。

model_acceptance_contract.current_authorization_rule: Only a complete model-acceptance.v2 record bound to the exact current input can create current authorization.
model_acceptance_contract.execution_provenance_rule: model-acceptance.v2 is structural decision evidence, not cryptographic proof that a provider model executed. Repository merge authority additionally requires the trusted-model-review exact-diff check after its documented bootstrap; audio claims separately require exact media consumption evidence.
model_acceptance_contract.canonical_input_rule: Content review and authorization input hashes use scripts/lib/model_acceptance.mjs#buildModelAcceptanceInputSha256 and bind decision type, exact sorted scope, current corpus fingerprint, exact scoped-audit SHA-256, and linked review path/SHA-256 when authorization consumes a review. A full_track_content_authorization additionally binds the exact canonical runtime content_version through additionalBindings.content_version; validators derive that version from one direct immutable runtime payload, rehash its bytes, and require exact track/card scope. Changing the payload or runtime version invalidates authorization.
model_acceptance_contract.legacy_v1_rule: Records that claim user confirmation, user approval, or a human reviewer remain immutable historical evidence only and never create current authorization. They must not be rewritten to look model-owned.

workflow.generate: The model may generate the complete authorized scope without a staged sample pause.
workflow.review: A model reviewer records exact-scope semantic evidence; deterministic validators independently replay structural, scope, hash, and audit invariants.
workflow.authorize: The harness may create current content authorization only when model acceptance is accepted and every required deterministic gate passes on the same immutable input.
workflow.audio: An audio-capable model may record perceptual evidence only after consuming the exact bound asset; technical probing remains independently required.
workflow.remove: The harness may remove a card only with model destructive-change acceptance bound to the base card identity and proof that current references and required coverage remain valid.
workflow.merge: The agent merges validated content, audio, authorization, tooling, and harness PRs after exact-head required checks pass.

non_negotiable_invariants: exact immutable commit and scope binding
current card corpus fingerprint and scoped audit replay
full-track formal content authorization binds the exact canonical runtime content_version and cannot replay across runtime versions
complete changed-card metadata and answer-reference parity
zero unresolved hard blockers for an accepted scope
source provenance remains explicit and AI or simulated content is never presented as true-exam content
audio perceptual acceptance requires actual complete asset consumption by an audio-capable model
technical audio hashes, byte sizes, decoder probes, durations, and transcript bindings remain independently verified
unknown legacy audio provider, voice, or generator facts remain unknown
no deployment, device, GitHub, source-authenticity, or other external fact is inferred or fabricated
payload, harness, and audio asset changes remain separate review units
failed or incomplete required gates prevent authorization and merge

content_authorization_record.ordinary_scoped_authorization_runtime_ve: not_required_when_no_canonical_runtime_version_exists; when declared it is validated and bound

historical_compatibility.policy: Existing v1 records are immutable archive evidence. New current authorization must use model-acceptance.v2 and must not derive authority from a legacy record.

actions: use a capable model or deterministic tool
record a machine-visible blocker and continue independent work
regenerate or reject the affected artifact
